title: For We Are Many
author: Dennis E. Taylor
summary: Bob is a software copy of a man who died, now running as a self-replicating space probe and exploring the stars. In this second Bobiverse book, the growing group of Bobs spread out, each with their own mission and their own problems.
readIf: you like cheerful, nerdy science fiction with a lot of problem-solving and affectionate humour.
skipIf: you have not read We Are Legion (We Are Bob), since this picks up directly from it.

pairings.reason: Another warm, funny science-fiction story about clever problem-solving far from home.
The first book in the Bobiverse, the best place to begin.
A comic science-fiction story that treats its own premise with similar irreverence.
